boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented recurring Marywood observances, service projects, and community rituals with direct university evidence.

cards.title: Search XXXVI Retreat
cards.subtitle: Marywood Campus Ministry tradition
cards.notes: Watch Campus Ministry announcements for the next retreat, then join the reflection, faith-sharing, and community-building weekend if registration is offered.
cards.short_summary: A student-led retreat tradition that Marywood says has continued for 36 years.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood reported that Search XXXVI was its annual, student-led Search Retreat and that the Campus Ministry tradition has continued unbroken for 36 years.
cards.source_title: Marywood Students Continue Tradition with Search XXXVI Retreat
cards.access_notes: The 2026 retreat was held off campus at Holy Transfiguration Retreat Center; confirm future registration and location with Campus Ministry.

cards.title: The 1919 Commencement Eucharist
cards.subtitle: Marian Chapel, Swartz Center for Spiritual Life
cards.notes: If you are graduating or supporting a graduate, check the commencement schedule and arrive before the listed seating time for this shared blessing.
cards.short_summary: Marywood’s graduation-week Eucharistic celebration dates to 1919.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood identifies the Eucharistic celebration asking God’s blessing on graduates as a university tradition since 1919.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 page lists the liturgy in Marian Chapel and invites faculty, graduates, families, and guests; consult the current commencement page for updates.

cards.title: Rotunda Christmas Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: Liberal Arts Center Rotunda
cards.notes: Check Marywood’s holiday announcements for the date, then gather in the Rotunda for seasonal music and the annual lighting ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus gathering centered on the Christmas tree in the Rotunda.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood calls its Christmas Tree Lighting the signature event of its annual Christmas-season celebration and states that it is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Marywood University Celebrating the Holiday Season by “Making Spirits Bright”
cards.access_notes: The cited 2024 announcement scheduled the event in the Liberal Arts Center Rotunda; verify the current year’s date and access details.

cards.title: Making Spirits Bright Season
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide, December through New Year’s Eve
cards.notes: Use the holiday calendar to choose a service, spiritual, or festive program that fits your schedule during Marywood’s seasonal observance.
cards.short_summary: Marywood’s annual umbrella celebration for holiday programming, service, and spiritual opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood describes “Making Spirits Bright” as its annual Christmas-season celebration spanning festive programming, community service, spiritual opportunities, and student and alumni events.
cards.source_title: Marywood University Celebrating the Holiday Season by “Making Spirits Bright”
cards.access_notes: The cited program ran from December through New Year’s Eve; future offerings and participation details vary by year.

cards.title: Choose a Christmas Giving Tree Tag
cards.subtitle: Marywood holiday service project
cards.notes: When the project returns, take an available tag, follow its gift request, and deliver the unwrapped item with its tag by the stated deadline.
cards.short_summary: A campus gift-collection project connected to Marywood’s holiday service programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood documented an on-campus Christmas Giving Tree project and instructed community members to select a tag and return the requested unwrapped gift with it.
cards.access_notes: Gift requests, beneficiaries, deadlines, and drop-off locations are announced for each holiday season.

cards.title: Breakfast with Santa
cards.subtitle: Nazareth Student Center, Latour Room
cards.notes: Watch Alumni Engagement notices early; this traditional family event has limited seating and may require advance registration before it fills.
cards.short_summary: A recurring holiday gathering hosted by the NEPA Marywood Alumni Chapter with Alumni Engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood describes Breakfast with Santa as a traditional event hosted by its NEPA Alumni Chapter with the Office of Alumni Engagement.
cards.source_title: Marywood University Celebrating the Holiday Season by “Making Spirits Bright”
cards.access_notes: The cited announcement listed the Latour Room and noted that tickets had sold out; confirm future availability and registration.

cards.title: Holiday Music at Marywood Heights
cards.subtitle: Marywood Heights; Marywood Wind Ensemble tradition
cards.notes: If you are a Marywood Heights resident or staff member, check the concert calendar for this community-facing holiday performance by the Wind Ensemble.
cards.short_summary: A recurring holiday program presented by Marywood’s Wind Ensemble for the Marywood Heights community.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood’s event calendar says the Wind Ensemble continues its tradition of presenting a free concert of traditional holiday music at Marywood Heights.
cards.source_title: Ignite The Light Calendar of Events
cards.access_notes: The cited calendar specifies that this concert is only for Marywood Heights residents and staff.

cards.title: Marywood Day of Service
cards.subtitle: Marywood Alumni community service observance
cards.notes: Look for the Alumni Board’s annual schedule and sign up through the announced channel when the next service-day details are posted.
cards.short_summary: A named annual service day included in Marywood Alumni Board programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood’s Alumni Board schedule lists Marywood Day of Service as a named annual-programming date, with the 2026 date set for April 18.
cards.access_notes: The source lists the 2025–26 schedule only; confirm the next date, projects, and participation requirements with Alumni Engagement.

cards.title: Celebrate Marywood Garden Party
cards.subtitle: Motherhouse and Seminary Morgan Memorial Garden
cards.notes: Follow University Advancement announcements for the annual event’s honorees, tickets, and program, which supports a designated campus priority.
cards.short_summary: Marywood’s annual signature fundraising celebration, held outdoors on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood describes Celebrate Marywood as its annual signature fundraising event, created in 2014 to honor regional service and strengthen university-community connections.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 event was held outdoors in the Motherhouse and Seminary Morgan Memorial Garden; tickets and sponsorships were offered.

cards.entity_name: Cor Mariae and Years of Service Recognition
cards.title: Cor Mariae Recognition
cards.subtitle: Marywood faculty and staff milestone observance
cards.notes: Follow university news for the annual recognition and learn which faculty and staff are being honored for long-term service and contributions.
cards.short_summary: An annual Marywood recognition rooted in the university’s 1965 Jubilee Year.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood states that the Cor Mariae and Years of Service Recognition originated in its 1965 Jubilee Year and continues as an annual event honoring faculty and staff service.
cards.source_title: Cor Mariae and Years of Service Recognition Celebrates Marywood Faculty and Staff Milestones
cards.access_notes: This recognition is focused on faculty and staff milestone service and Cor Mariae Medal recipients; attendance details are not stated in the source.
